title: Microsoft Purview: run a Power Automate flow when a retention label's retention period ends (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately reports the planned government-cloud rollout, the administrator-controlled default and the documented configuration and licensing requirements. The portal path and PowerShell parameter are supported, and the briefing explicitly reports the differing status in Microsoft's cloud planning tables.

claims.claim: New-ComplianceTag -Name <label name> -FlowId <flow GUID> creates a retention label specifying the flow to run at the end of retention.
claims.quote:
Use the New-ComplianceTag cmdlet to create retention labels in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Retention labels apply retention settings to content.
The FlowId parameter specifies the Power Automate flow to run at the end of the retention period.
